boards.name: BOOST-DRV8848 Dual Brushed Motor BoosterPack
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit implementation of Texas Instruments' BOOST-DRV8848 revision-A BoosterPack. The board follows TI's published hardware design and uses the DRV8848 dual H-bridge driver to control one or two brushed DC motors from a compatible LaunchPad.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM Motor-Drive BoosterPack
boards.description: This project is a tscircuit reference implementation inspired by Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM. It recreates the board's main electrical architecture and LaunchPad XL interface from TI's BOOSTXL-DRV8305EVM User's Guide.

boards.name: Educational BoosterPack TS
boards.description: A two-layer tscircuit board inspired by TI's BOOSTXL-EDUMKII Educational BoosterPack. It retains the wide, rounded BoosterPack form factor and combines a display, environmental and motion sensors, user controls, audio I/O, lighting, and a servo connector on one LaunchPad XL-compatible board.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-TLV8544PIR tscircuit reconstruction
boards.description: This is an engineering reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-TLV8544PIR PIR motion-detector BoosterPack.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-TMP107 tscircuit reconstruction
boards.description: This project reconstructs the Texas Instruments BOOSTXL-TMP107 BoosterPack in tscircuit. The electrical design follows TI's MHR035 Rev A schematic in the official BOOSTXL-TMP107 user guide. The board includes the LaunchPad headers, selectable UART transmit path, main TMP107, and two breakaway TMP107 sensor nodes.

boards.name: BOOSTXL-ULN2003 dual stepper-motor BoosterPack
boards.description: Native tscircuit reconstruction of Texas Instruments' BOOSTXL-ULN2003 BoosterPack. The electrical design follows the official SLCU002 schematic and includes the fitted ULN2003 driver path, eighth CSD17571Q2 output, serial/parallel control, mode switches, status LEDs, motor connectors, supply protection, and DNP alternatives.
